species_breeds: African cattle (40 indigenous breeds: Taurine, Zebu, Sanga, Zenga)
question: Generate a public, high-density genomic reference resource for African cattle
methods: Illumina BovineHD (777k) & WGS mapped to ARS-UCD1.2, basic PCA and variant call QC
main_findings: Described data generation, variant call metrics, and broad continental PCA clustering
limitations: Strictly a data descriptor; no ROH profiling, no inbreeding load analysis, no autozygosity island mapping, no lineage-stratified F_ROH
code_availability: Data on Zenodo; pipeline scripts descriptive only
differentiation_of_proposed_work: First study to conduct systematic, multi-length-class ROH profiling, genomic inbreeding (F_ROH) quantification, and autozygosity island fine-mapping across all 40 breeds in this HD dataset

species_breeds: Indigenous African cattle (16 breeds across East/West Africa)
question: Dissect the mosaic ancestral history and adaptive introgression in African cattle
methods: Whole-genome resequencing (~15-20x), local ancestry inference, demographic modeling (dadi), selection scans (XP-EHH)
main_findings: Identified taurine-indicine admixture 750-1050 years ago; mapped 16 adaptive introgression loci including trypanotolerance and heat tolerance
limitations: Sample size modest (N=172 across 16 breeds, ~10 per breed); focused on ancestry deconvolution rather than autozygosity architecture
differentiation_of_proposed_work: Analyzes large HD cohort (N=1063 across 40 breeds); focuses specifically on autozygosity dynamics, recent vs ancient inbreeding, and autozygosity hotspots

citation: Nandolo et al., Genet Sel Evol
species_breeds: European & African cattle (Tyrolean Grey, Fleckvieh, Brown Swiss, etc.)
question: Assess reliability of ROH islands and detect false positives caused by marker gaps and CNVs
methods: PLINK sliding-window ROH, comparison of 50K vs HD arrays, CNV overlap analysis
main_findings: Demonstrated that low-density arrays suffer from artificial ROH islands due to marker gaps (>1 Mb) or hemizygous deletions; HD arrays provide uniform coverage
limitations: Focused primarily on Austrian and European breeds; limited representation of tropical indigenous African breeds
differentiation_of_proposed_work: Applies high-density marker density (BovineHD) to tropical indigenous lineages, mitigating marker-gap bias while profiling autozygosity in non-temperate pastoral breeds

species_breeds: Ethiopian indigenous cattle (Abergelle, Arado, Begait, Fogera)
question: Uncover genomic diversity and candidate selection signatures for environmental adaptation in Ethiopian cattle
methods: Whole-genome sequencing, F_ST, pi, XP-CLR scans, functional enrichment
main_findings: Detected candidate genes for thermotolerance, high-altitude hypoxia, and tick resistance
limitations: Very small sample size (N=11 per breed); localized exclusively to northern Ethiopia; no ROH size class stratification
differentiation_of_proposed_work: Extends analysis from localized Ethiopian populations to continental scale (40 breeds across 10 nations) with high statistical power (N=1063)

species_breeds: Ethiopian Zebu, Sanga, and Taurine cattle
question: Examine population structure, genetic diversity, and signatures of positive selection in Ethiopian breeds
methods: WGS, PCA, ADMIXTURE, pairwise F_ST, nucleotide diversity ratios
main_findings: Demonstrated tri-hybrid ancestral composition of Ethiopian cattle; identified immune and metabolic adaptation loci
limitations: Restricted to 40 samples from 4 breeds; lack of sub-megabase autozygosity analysis
differentiation_of_proposed_work: Provides comprehensive autozygosity dissection and inbreeding architecture across 1,063 animals and 40 breeds

citation: Makina et al., Genet Sel Evol
species_breeds: South African cattle (Afrikaner, Nguni, Bonsmara, Drakensberger)
question: Quantify genetic diversity, population structure, and linkage disequilibrium in South African cattle
methods: 50K SNP array, PLINK ROH, LD decay, effective population size (Ne)
main_findings: Indigenous breeds showed moderate diversity and low inbreeding compared to commercial composites
limitations: Used older 50K BeadChip with limited resolution for short (<2 Mb) ancestral ROH segments; confined to South Africa
differentiation_of_proposed_work: Uses modern ARS-UCD1.2 mapped 777K HD array capturing fine-scale ancient autozygosity (<2 Mb) across East, West, and Central Africa

question: Map worldwide patterns of ancestry, divergence, and admixture in domesticated cattle
methods: TreeMix, PCA, f-statistics on 50K SNP data
main_findings: Traced cattle domestication routes, divergence of indicine and taurine, and global admixture waves
limitations: Array ascertainment bias favoring European taurine; did not examine runs of homozygosity or autozygosity islands
differentiation_of_proposed_work: Focuses specifically on autozygosity landscapes, recent vs ancient inbreeding, and high-density autozygosity islands in indigenous African tropical cattle
